name: Makino Shiori
source:
The homeroom teacher of Serina and co at the Kashima school.

A zealous educator who took the job of being the homeroom teacher of the problem child, Yukinojou. Bound by the sense of duty and responsibility, she's definitely an ideal female teacher. She's also smart and has strong maternal instinct. She gently watches over her problematic pupils, while also occasionally helping them.
